references.text: The Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and she bore a son to Abraham. This is a parallel to how God's promise of a son was fulfilled.
Hannah bore a son and named him Samuel, because she had prayed to the Lord for him. Both mothers received sons through God's intervention and gave them significant names.
Samuel grew up in the presence of the Lord. In the same way, Samson grew up and the Lord blessed him.
Elizabeth bore a son after the angel's message. John's birth has parallels to Samson's birth; both were foretold by angels.
The child grew and became strong in spirit. This describes John the Baptist's upbringing in a similar way to Samson's growth and blessing.
The Jesus-child grew and became strong, filled with wisdom, and God's grace was upon him. A similar description of divine blessing over a child.
Isaac prayed for his wife Rebekah because she was barren, and the Lord answered him. God's intervention in cases of infertility is a recurring theme.
